title: Calibrations in Dexcom are causing duplicate value alerts and suspending closed loop
symptom: Any time a calibration is entered in Dexcom, APS shows a red exclamation next to the blood sugar and a glucose value is marked as an out of normal sequence duplicate. This occurs even when Dexcom does not accept the calibration and shows no duplicate readings. The flagged duplicate has a different time stamp, confirming it is not a duplicate. This breaks the loop, requiring manual deletion of the supposed duplicate and restarting the loop.
cause: diaKem sending double values to AAPS is a known problem.
evidence_quote: diaKem sending doube values to AAPS is a known problem.
